QuestInfo.name: The Alliance Gathers
QuestInfo.0: What could Neinheart be calling you about?
QuestInfo.1:
In a rare move from the Empress, the conference will take place away from Ereve. With her safety being an obvious point of concern, all the Chief Knights will protect her around the clock.

#b(If there's a problem during the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Under the watchful eyes of the Chief Knights, the Empress has made her way to Victoria Island. She should be perfectly safe...
